name: Harb Clawhoof
summary: Near Bloodhoof Village, Harb Clawhoof cares for the kodos that carry tauren across the plains. He entrusts them to worthy tauren riders and champions trusted by Thunder Bluff.

sections.title: Breeder of the Great Kodo
sections.body: Near Bloodhoof Village, Harb Clawhoof tends the kodos. Great beasts, they carry heavy loads over long distances and serve tauren travel and work across the plains. Harb cares for each one and trains it. Then he pairs it with a rider respected by the tauren people.

sections.title: Steeds of the Plains
sections.body: Tauren earn the trust needed to ride Harb’s kodos, while outsiders face closer scrutiny. Their size and temperament make kodos hard for the unfamiliar to guide. So non-tauren allies must prove their loyalty and earn exalted standing with Thunder Bluff before riding one of Harb’s mounts.

faq.q: Where can I find Harb Clawhoof?
faq.answer: You can find Harb Clawhoof at the kodo corral on Bloodhoof Village’s outskirts in central Mulgore, just south of Thunder Bluff.
Harb sells several kinds of kodo mounts, including brown and gray kodos and heavily armored great kodos for seasoned riders.

faq.q: Can non-tauren buy kodos from Harb?
faq.answer: Yes. Tauren can buy kodos directly. Other Horde races must earn exalted standing with Thunder Bluff and prove themselves to the tribe before Harb entrusts them with one.

faq.q: Why are kodos so important to the tauren?
faq.answer: Kodos suit the tauren’s nomadic life and the open plains of central Kalimdor. They carry burdens, serve as war mounts, and carry trade across the rugged land.

angles.text: As a tauren, you can receive a mount tied to your heritage from Harb Clawhoof. It suits travel across Mulgore and your nomadic traditions.
As an orc, troll, or Forsaken, earning a kodo from Harb marks honor and friendship recognized by the elders of Thunder Bluff.
